subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 5: Project – A school bag + Sound r
outcomes: I can make a paper school bag and say what is in it.
I can say I've got … and I haven't got … about my bag.
I can say the sound /r/ and read rat and rip.

tf.s: Step 1 of the project is: press out the bag.
tf.why: Yes! First we press out the bag.

tf.s: We put the paper school things in the bag.
tf.why: Yes! Then we put the things in.

tf.s: We pack our real school bag carefully.
tf.why: Great! We look after our things.

tf.s: I haven't got a ruler means I have a ruler.
tf.why: It means there is no ruler.

tf.s: Red starts with the letter h.
A rabbit is a school thing.

boxes.q: What do we make in the project?
boxes.why: We make a paper school bag.

boxes.q: After we press out the bag, we …
boxes.why: We colour the bag and the things.

boxes.q: I've got a book and a …
boxes.why: A ruler is a school thing.

boxes.q: No pen in my bag. I … a pen.

hunt.q: Catch a school thing for the bag.

mcq.q: Which of these words starts with /r/?
What is step 1 of the project?
mcq.why: First we press out the bag.

mcq.q: Which one is NOT a school thing?
Which sentence is for a thing you do NOT have?
mcq.why: Haven't got means you don't have it.

mcq.q: Your bag has a book and a ruler, but no pen. You say …
o: I've got a book and a ruler. I haven't got a pen.
mcq.why: Say what is in the bag and what is not.

mcq.q: The song says crayon. What do you hold up?
mcq.why: Hold up the thing you hear.

mcq.q: _un: the word is run. Which letter is missing?
Why do we pack our school bag carefully?
o: To give it to the cat.

mcq.q: Which word does NOT start with /r/?
Rat and cat. What is different?
mcq.why: r-at and c-at: only the first sound changes.
